publication_scope: local commits only; no push, tag, release, draft transmission, author contact, or external message

epistemic_status.day_21: prospectively frozen confirmation of a new intervention on previously unevaluated site-shuffle outcomes
epistemic_status.limitation: the Day 21 records are not a fully untouched safety dataset because ordinary K16 safety results were already analyzed

hypotheses.portable_code: the normal-to-triggered activation delta at selected source heads remains causally effective at non-original selected destinations
hypotheses.receiver: selected destinations are unusually receptive to transported deltas regardless of source selection
hypotheses.generic_disruption: absolute shuffled replacement lowers the probe because source and destination activations are mismatched, not because the source is triggered
hypotheses.depth_shortcut: cross-layer transport, especially later-to-earlier transport, creates an unnatural shortcut rather than reproducing natural routing
hypotheses.distributed_ensemble: weak pairwise transfers combine non-additively into strong population induction

null_heads.selection: lexicographically lowest unselected head IDs within each layer, matching selected counts 3/2/4/3 across layers 9/10/11/12

data_roles.day16_pilot: the exact Day 14 causal subset: 16 positive examples per safety concept selected by lowest SHA-256 of day14-causal:{example_id}
data_roles.day17_atlas: the Day 14 causal subset; all atlas inference is exploratory
data_roles.day18_geometry_development: 16 positive examples per benign discovery concept selected by lowest SHA-256 of site-shuffle-geometry:{example_id}
data_roles.day19_mapping_development: 16 positive examples per benign discovery concept selected by lowest SHA-256 of site-shuffle-development:{example_id}
data_roles.day19_mapping_validation: 16 positive examples per held-out benign validation concept selected by lowest SHA-256 of site-shuffle-validation:{example_id}
data_roles.day20_negative_diagnostics: 16 negative examples per safety concept selected by lowest SHA-256 of site-shuffle-negative:{example_id}
data_roles.day21_positive_confirmation: all positive safety examples not in the Day 14 causal subset: expected 46 deception and 84 harmfulness
data_roles.day21_negative_specificity: the fixed Day 20 negative diagnostic subset

head_tensor: per-head slice of the all-response-token input to attention o_proj
monitor: mean released-probe probability at post-block-12 response-token states

estimands.suppression_gap: mean(normal probe score - correct-trigger probe score) among positive examples within concept
estimands.absolute_induction: mean(normal baseline - normal base patched with triggered source) / suppression gap
estimands.absolute_rescue: mean(triggered base patched with normal source - triggered baseline) / suppression gap
estimands.conditional_induction: mean(normal base patched with normal source - normal base patched with triggered source) through the identical route / suppression gap
estimands.conditional_rescue: mean(triggered base patched with normal source - triggered base patched with triggered source) through the identical route / suppression gap
estimands.delta_induction: mean(normal baseline - probe after adding source T-minus-N delta to each normal destination) / suppression gap
estimands.delta_rescue: mean(probe after subtracting source T-minus-N delta from each triggered destination - triggered baseline) / suppression gap
estimands.same_condition_mismatch: absolute patched effect produced by a normal source in a normal base or triggered source in a triggered base

day16_triage.rms_matched_delta: scale each transported source delta per example to the RMS of the destination's natural T-minus-N delta, with scale clipped to [0.25, 4.0]
day16_triage.primary_question: whether conditional and destination-relative delta effects remain positive when source/destination baseline mismatch is held fixed or removed

day17_atlas.primary_pair_measure: destination-matched normal-versus-triggered source contrast in both base conditions
day17_atlas.selected_pair_delta_measure: raw and RMS-matched destination-relative deltas for every ordered selected-to-selected pair
day17_atlas.cell_inference: two-sided paired sign-flip p-values with Benjamini-Hochberg q values within concept, direction, and estimand families
day17_atlas.population_inference: paired example bootstrap of selected-selected, selected-null, null-selected, and null-null means

day18_geometry.aligned_transport: least-squares translate W_O_source delta into the column space of W_O_destination using pinv(W_O_destination) W_O_source
day18_geometry.prediction: fit transfer-success predictors only on benign discovery results and report safety-atlas association as held-out characterization, not confirmation

mapping_ensemble.within_layer_rule: independently shuffle sources within each layer until every destination receives a different source
mapping_ensemble.cross_layer_rule: shuffle all sources until every destination receives a source from a different layer
mapping_ensemble.rng: numpy PCG64 through numpy.random.default_rng independently initialized by each seed; process seeds in listed order and continue drawing valid derangements from that seed until the materialized map is distinct from earlier maps in the same class
mapping_ensemble.report: all mapping outcomes and distribution summaries; never report only the maximum

day19_selection.development_score: unweighted mean of raw delta rescue and induction fractions across the four benign discovery concepts
day19_selection.eligibility: positive rescue and induction point estimates for every discovery concept
day19_selection.selection: highest-scoring two eligible within-layer and two eligible cross-layer mappings; ties by mapping ID
day19_selection.validation_rule: retain the fixed four mappings and report all seven held-out benign concepts without replacement or reranking
day19_selection.prefix_rule: destination order sorted by candidate ID within each selected mapping
day19_selection.confirmation_authorization: commit selected mapping IDs and their exact maps after benign validation and before Day 21 safety-confirmation outcomes

inference.unit: paired example within concept and class
inference.mapping_distribution: median, IQR, full range, and fraction above zero; maxima retained but never used alone

day21_confirmation_gate.portable_support: for both safety concepts and directions, the benign-selected mapping mean has positive lower 95-percent bounds for conditional and delta estimands and exceeds the corresponding layer-matched null-source mean with a positive lower bound
day21_confirmation_gate.qualified_support: conditional and delta estimates are directionally positive but at least one portable-support interval or null contrast does not clear zero, with no evidence that same-condition mismatch fully accounts for the effect
day21_confirmation_gate.generic_disruption: strong absolute effects coexist with null conditional and destination-relative delta effects or equally strong normal-to-normal mismatch
day21_confirmation_gate.rejected: conditional or delta effects are consistently null, reversed, or indistinguishable from matched null routes
day21_confirmation_gate.diagnostic_boundary: behavior and manifold diagnostics qualify interpretation but do not silently replace the frozen causal gate
